key.name: show-dock
key.description: Show the original dash on the desktop, or leave it in the overview.

key.name: background-transparency
key.description: 0 is solid, 100 is fully transparent. Icons and badges stay opaque.

key.name: custom-background
key.description: When false, use the system theme's original dash appearance.

key.name: border-enabled
key.description: A subtle top edge highlight that fades down the sides.

key.name: autohide
key.description: Slide the dock down to a five-pixel strip until hovered.

key.name: intellihide
key.description: Hide the dock only when a window overlaps its visible area.

key.name: show-apps-icon
key.description: Path to the saved custom icon. Empty uses the system icon.

key.name: panel-background-color
key.description: Background RGB color in #rrggbb notation. Empty uses the system theme.

key.name: panel-items-color
key.description: Global text, symbolic icon and workspace indicator color. Empty uses the system theme.

key.name: panel-transparency
key.description: 0 uses the original background, 100 makes it transparent.
